title: Computer Hardware
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Pre-Technical Studies; not yet checked by a Pre-Technical Studies teacher; safety lines marked SAFETY in the library to confirm first; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner classifies hardware devices as input (keyboard, mouse, scanner, microphone, camera), output (softcopy: monitor, speakers; hardcopy: printer), processing (CPU) or storage (hard disk, flash disk, memory card), and picks the device for a task; using the devices is marked with the rubric.
representations: a printout and a screen side by side
steps: For output, decide softcopy or hardcopy.
Pick the device for a task.

board.do: Draw arrows: input → computer → output, with storage below.

board.say: Where does it go on the chart?

board.do: Wait for the learner to say input.

misconceptions.ask: A printer is a type of what?
misconceptions.repair: Follow the direction: data flows from the computer to the printer, so it is output.
Softcopy is shown on a screen or played; hardcopy is printed on paper you can hold.

misconceptions.ask: A scanner sends a picture into the computer. What is it?
misconceptions.repair: Scan a page and see it appear on screen: data goes into the computer, so it is input.

misconceptions.ask: A flash disk keeps files. What is it?
misconceptions.repair: Say storage keeps data for later; a flash disk can hold files on and off the computer.

checks.question: Is a printer input or output?
A flash disk is which kind of device?
